info.title: Economic Indicators API
info.description: This API contains analysis of current and historical data for the economic forecast

get.summary: Get economic indicator information for a specific indicator
get.description:
Fannie Mae’s Economic & Strategic Research Group provides analysis of current and historical data and forecasts economic trends in the housing and mortgage-finance markets.
 --- 
This call will return all available data for a specific indicator.
---
An array of **indicatorTimeSeries**, which is data from a single report, is returned containing the following information.
*effectiveDate*: The date the report was released.
*indicator-name*: The name of the indicator that the data is for.
*points*: An array of **Points**, containing value data.

---
A **Point** contains the following information.
*forecast*: True if the data is forecasted, false if it is historical.
*quarter*: The quarter of the data point. Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, or EOY.
*year*: The data point year in yyyy format.
*value*: The data value, a double

404.description: No economic indicator data found for {indicator}.

500.description: An error occurred while getting economic indicators data.

*indicator-name*: The name of the indicator that the data is for.

*year*: The data point year in yyyy format.
*value*: The data value, a double

parameters.description: The year is expected in the format of yyyy.
